relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: It was further found that high levels of serum MMP-2 and MMP-9 were risk factors for poor healing

relationships.subject: TIMP-1
relationships.evidence_quote: while high concentrations of serum TIMP-1 at 24 h after surgery were protective factors for poor healing

key_findings: High serum MMP-2/MMP-9 and low TIMP-1 at 24 h predict poor healing after perianal fistula surgery
